notes.title: 1.4 Symbol Update
notes.content:
[h1]IsoBoom has just been updated to version 1.4 ![/h1]

It's a very small update although a real treat for artistic profile enthusiasts.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Minor bugfixes / performance fixes.
    [*]Added full alphabet + 0-9 digits + other cool symbols as achievements in 2 color schemes. The symbols have 25% chance to drop from wooden crates destroyed with bombs. You can then use those achievements for your steam showcases. The achievements can also be unlocked in the same manner on custom maps. 
[/list]

notes.content:
Very small patch based on the idea from one of the reviews:

 [list]
    [*]Increased the speed of loading levels.
    [*]Shortened the delay when restarting a map.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Following things have been fixed in the 1.2 patch:

[list]
    [*]Fixed a glitch where playing a custom map would corrupt the game save and would make it impossible to continue the main story.
    [*]Added a possibility to close the In-Game menu by pressing the Escape key.
    [*]Fixed a glitch where it was impossible to get the "Bomb Kicker" achievement while using a keyboard.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1 Patch - Continue Functionality
notes.content:
"Continue" button has been added in the main menu which allows you to continue your adventure without having to start all over. Your progress is being saved every time when you advance to the next level or when you go back to the main menu or exit the game using the "Exit" button.

For those of you who still wish to have more "hardcore" experience. You can still use the "New Game" button to start over and enjoy the game in the originally intended way.

You might need to restart your Steam Client to get the update.
